w:r.w:t: This Real Estate Purchase and Sale Agreement Amendment is made by and between:
The parties of the First part, hereby referred to as the “BUYER(S)”
Tania Ramirez Matos and Miguel A Molino Berrios, both of legal age, married to each other, residents of San Juan, Puerto Rico
The parties of the Second part, here
Roberta Meyers Edmisten and John Hoyt Edmisten, both of legal age, married to each other, residents of Boone, North Carolina
and the SELLER(S) agree to Sell the property described as follows:
del Coronel, Flamenco Ward, Culebra, Puerto Rico 00775

This Purchase and Sale Agreement Amendment is to Amend the current Purchase and Sale Agreement between the parties which was signed by the Sellers on 2/7/2024 and by the Buyers on 2/13/2024. The Amendments to this Agreement follow.
included and excluded items in the sale will be amended as follows.

All contents of the property in an as is where is condition, including, but not limited to, all current contents, appliances, furnishings, kitchen appliances, laundry appliances, household goods, furnishings, blinds, window treatments, affixed lamps, air conditioners, wáter heater(s), utility systems, furniture, kitchenware, on site construction materials, wood on the site, panels on site, rebar on site, PVC on site,

Jacks (Lollly poles) in use on the property, etc... except the items listed below identified as “This sale does not include:” Any applicable transferable warranties on equipment and appliances in the property will be transferred from the SELLER(S) to the BUYER(S) at closing.
All items included in this sale are being sold in an As Is Where Is condition with no guarantee or warranty of manufacture or function for any items included in this sale.
Personal items such as clothes and
Jackes (Lolly poles) not in use on the property
The purchase price of the property will be amended to SEVEN HUNDRED THOUSAND DOLLARS ($700,000) payable as follows.
EARNEST MONEY DEPOSIT already in escrow (the “Earnest Money Deposit”)
The Purchase and Sale Agreement is further
The closing date for the sale will be extended to complete the sale on or before July 24
Sale Agreement between the parties will remain in full force.
This Amendment is hereby agreed to by the parties.
Lisa Penfield, Real Estate Broker license C-9931
